add.title: Inbox own_notes: no page.jsonl fetch for a routed url (parent has no listing)
add.why: own_notes (Inbox.js:51-55) only skips the fetch when the parent's listing is known and says not-jsonl; when the parent has no listing at all (a routed url like /live/settings/doc/ or /live/settings/LivePage.js/) it fetches <path>page.jsonl and 404s 4 times per open at widths that show the inbox rail (seen at 1920 on main, 2026-11-06). Fix idea: also skip when Page.route made the page (no folder on disk), or when the parent listing is null and the page has no jsonl_lines; check jsonl pages under date folders without files.jsonl before tightening.
